source_references.title: Trimble business model reinvention: $1.4B ARR: PwC

business_problem: Trimble needed to unify fragmented CRM, ERP, product-catalog, and go-to-market processes so it could shift from siloed point-product sales to a scalable SaaS model with one customer experience.
solution_summary: PwC rewired Trimble’s AECO business around a Salesforce-centered revenue stack so one customer journey could span marketing, sales, subscriptions, billing, and service. The transformation replaced eight disconnected marketing tools with Salesforce Marketing Cloud integrated to Salesforce Data Cloud, creating shared profiles from web activity, product trials, transactions, and renewal data for automated campaigns and lead scoring. PwC also implemented a single customer platform so buyers could receive one quote, contract, and invoice while internal teams worked from shared CRM and operations workflows. Agentforce Revenue Management anchors subscription changes and renewals, while a virtual SDR, AI-driven quoting tool, and conversational invoice agent automate prospect follow-up, pricing, and billing support. Together these components turned go-to-market motions into a data-driven SaaS operating model that supports faster selling, larger deals, and recurring-revenue growth.

data_flow: Web activity, product-trial, transaction, and renewal data flow into Salesforce Data Cloud, where shared profiles feed Marketing Cloud campaigns, lead-scoring models, sellers, and the virtual SDR. Qualified opportunities move through AI-assisted quoting and Agentforce Revenue Management, then into a single portal and invoice workflow where the conversational invoice agent handles billing questions in real time.
business_outcome: Trimble grew recurring revenue past $1.4 billion, doubled cross-sell sales, sped quote cycles by 40%, and gave customers a unified buying and billing experience while sales and operations teams worked from one connected platform.
metrics: $1.4B+ in recurring revenue—driven by a subscription-first business model
2X growth in cross-sell sales—expanding value across the customer base
40% faster quote cycles—accelerating deal velocity and time to close
95% of Trimble AECO’s revenue is recurring
architecture_clues: Eight disconnected tools were replaced with Salesforce Marketing Cloud integrated with Salesforce Data Cloud.
The operating model gives customers one website, one seller, one quote, one contract, and one invoice.
Customer engagement data spans web activity, product trials, transactions, and renewals with consent and privacy controls.
A single account experience portal connects customers to unified CRM and back-office workflows.
evidence_quotes: Eight disconnected tools were replaced with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and integrated with Salesforce Data Cloud.
Customer engagement data is captured to fuel AI that can help pinpoint when customers are ready to buy, how to engage them, and when to act.
With PwC’s help, Trimble introduced a virtual sales development representative that automatically follows up with prospects, identifies real interest, and passes qualified leads to sales.

An AI-driven quoting tool further simplifies complex deal configurations and pricing, speeding up the sales process. AI also transformed customer service with a conversational invoice agent providing real-time billing support, resolving disputes instantly.
Annual recurring revenue has grown consistently, climbing to more than $1.4 billion.
